name: Life Time Miami Half Marathon
summary: The Life Time Miami Half Marathon is run with the Miami Marathon on the same course until a breakaway point, then finishes at the same line at Bayfront Park. The organisers call it an almost all-flat course across Miami and Miami Beach, with views of the city and the ocean. The only rises are a few bridges.
courseHighlights: Start at 601 Biscayne Boulevard, in front of the Kaseya Center
MacArthur Causeway bridge a quarter mile into the race
Venetian Causeway on the way back to the mainland

paceStrategy.summary: The race site says Miami and Miami Beach are at sea level with no noticeable elevation changes, except for a few bridges. Keep an even pace and take it easy up the bridges, where the climb comes early.

segments.terrain: Biscayne Boulevard, MacArthur Causeway bridge and the approach to Miami Beach
segments.advice: Go up the first bridge at an easy effort and hold back from the opening crowd.
Settle into goal pace and take fuel near mile 7.

segments.terrain: Venetian Causeway with a small final rise, then flat mainland to Bayfront Park
segments.advice: Keep steady over the causeway and push over the last mile.

fuelingNotes: The race site says aid stations start at mile 1.5 and appear about every mile, with water and Gatorade Endurance. Neversecond gels are at aid station F (about mile 7).
tips: Use the aid station at about mile 7 if you take Neversecond gels
Take note of the 'watch your step' list on the race site, including a narrow on-ramp near mile 0.2 and a sharp right turn near mile 3.6
Check the course map for the breakaway point where the half marathon separates from the marathon
If you signed up for the full marathon but drop to the half, you receive a half marathon finisher's medal

faq.question: Is the Miami Half Marathon flat?
faq.answer: Almost. The race site calls it almost all-flat. Miami and Miami Beach are at sea level, and a few bridges give very slight inclines.

faq.question: Where does the Miami Half Marathon start and finish?
faq.answer: It starts at 601 Biscayne Blvd in front of the Kaseya Center and finishes at Bayfront Park, the same finish as the marathon.

faq.question: When is the Miami Half Marathon held?
faq.answer: It is held on a Sunday in January.
